attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop; Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual source features: a bare high receding or nearly bald upper crown with very short grey/dark side hair, actual brow hair, a serious closed mouth, clean chin, and an understated pale grey upper-lip moustache shading. Retain the nearly black/navy open civilian jacket, real white shirt collar, and small black/dark necktie at the lower edge. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure, avoiding any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, or floating collar. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Maintain the complete tilted dark frame and opaque photographic backing in its actual source color. Include an attached cream note only if actually present in the source with its original marks and overlap; if no note exists, do not add any paper, pin, or attachment. Keep all solid surfaces opaque with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Retain the exact primary low-key side lighting, crop, and background. Fine primary details that are indistinct in the source must remain understated without inventing large dark moustaches, chin beards, or other accessories.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Strong IMAGE-LEFT near-profile/three-quarter civilian bust, BARE high receding/nearly bald upper crown with very short GREY/DARK side hair, actual brow HAIR, serious CLOSED mouth and clean chin, no spectacles. Understated pale GREY upper-lip moustache/shading is retained; fine primary strands genuinely indistinct, no invented large dark moustache or chin beard. Nearly BLACK/NAVY OPEN civilian jacket, real WHITE shirt collar and small BLACK/DARK necktie at lower edge beside note. Keep actual small-card sparse hair/left profile. Preserve exact primary low-key side lighting, crop and background.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve green-ringed black mascot eyes and real eyebrow HAIR. Do not copy human long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy; fit original neckline around compact round head. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decoration outside actually exposed source regions. Preserve an attached note ONLY where actually present; otherwise do not invent one. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
